note: Pre-declared #59 acceptance set. It records exact local fixtures and the six explicitly allowed public sources: the two tuned representative sources (Smelt, Blossem), the three repaired practice sources now representative/used_for_tuning (De Botanist, Mr Moos, Colonia Breda), and Gauchos Grill Breda as the only remaining evaluated_once holdout. A holdout has its own explicit state: unused, evaluated_once, or used_for_tuning. It never treats a reachable URL, a found PDF or an item count as proof of a complete menu. BE-21's wider vendor/OCR benchmark is out of scope.

schemaVersions.productMapping: existing receipt + concept contract; a lossless extension is design-only in planning/architecture/menu-extraction-product-schema-v2.md

requiredClasses.html: Static HTML headings, lists and repeated dish blocks.
requiredClasses.accordion_tabs: Tab/accordion panels whose DOM relation decides the menu variant and section.
requiredClasses.tables: Table rows and definition lists, including a price without a name.
requiredClasses.text_pdf: Digital text PDF, columns, baselines, multiple pages and price variants.
requiredClasses.scan_unreadable: Scan/image-only, encrypted or otherwise unreadable PDF; the product must report the limit, not OCR it.
requiredClasses.language_branch: Non-Dutch menu labels and a chain/location menu that must not be assigned to another branch.
requiredClasses.arrangement: Arrangement, choice menu, supplement or per-person price, kept out of ordinary dishes.
requiredClasses.price_variant: Glass/bottle, from-price or multiple undecomposed prices; never silently choose one.
requiredClasses.historical_cards: Existing Wolfslaar, Bardot, Zuyd and T-Huis snapshots as a shape regression, never current truth.
requiredClasses.safety_and_errors: Timeout, provider failure, invalid output, budget/page limits, reimport, concurrency, prompt injection, wrong branch and unsafe redirect.
requiredClasses.contract_mapping: One validated result reaching receipt, review, concept and export without silent flattening.
requiredClasses.review_surface: Shared uncertainty is reviewable per group; no accept-all action; duplicate and price blockers stay separate.
requiredClasses.browser_fixture: Existing import/review UI in an isolated local browser fixture; explicitly not live integration.

holdout.rule: A holdout has exactly three explicit states. `unused` is not fetched and carries no result. `evaluated_once` records exactly one independent first evaluation; it is still not a tuning source and may not be executed a second time on the same pinned source version. `used_for_tuning` is no longer a holdout: it must move to the representative set and a new unused holdout must be pinned. Smelt and Blossem were already used for tuning and are representative, never holdout.

evaluationStates.unused: Pinned but not fetched/evaluated. status is blocked or not_available; evaluationCount 0; no result.
evaluationStates.evaluated_once: One recorded first evaluation against the pinned source version. status may be executed, executed_with_limitation, blocked, unsupported or not_available; evaluationCount 1; result and firstEvaluatedAt are required; usedForTuning stays false.
evaluationStates.used_for_tuning: No longer a holdout. Forbidden in the holdout list: move the entry to representative and pin a new, unused holdout.

holdout.classCoverageReason: De Botanist, Mr Moos and Colonia were evaluated once and then used for the repairs in this round. They are now representative/used_for_tuning, not holdouts. Gauchos Breda remains the only evaluated_once holdout, with the original HTTP 404 outcome unchanged. No new unused external holdout is pinned in this round; that still needs its own source/access decision.
